title: Doorinia: The Yagha Coven War Host
description: Three High Hags and their coordinated armies, rebuilt from their Highforest origins for the conquered Domain of Delight of Doorinia. Includes 3 boss hags, 18 army minions, 3 signature war assets, and a GM tactics journal.
